Tharbad

Tharbad was a ford and fortified town at the river Gwathlo on the southern border of Eriador. 

 Size: 415 x 340

The Lone-lands

The Lone-lands was a name used by Hobbits for the wilderness east of Bree-land. This area contained, among other features, the Weather Hills and Weathertop. 

 Size: 350 x 360 
 Lairs: 2x Troll Lair, 2x Spider Lair, 2x Goblin Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 2x Inn
Shallows of Isen

A shallow point located near Isenford over which travellers on the Great Road could cross the river.

Frozen Shallows of Isen
